rca of the issue: Iter65 root cause was two-pronged: (1) backend EmailTestSendIn.to_email was required, so POST {template_id} alone returned 422 with a FastAPI validation-error array; (2) frontend sendTestToMe passed the array directly to react-hot-toast which tried to render objects as React children, throwing the runtime error and covering the page with the dev error overlay. Both legs fixed: (a) server.py made to_email Optional with admin email fallback (returns 200), (b) Admin.jsx imports formatApiError from lib/api and coerces detail to string before toast.error. Verified via both curl (backend) and Playwright UI (frontend) — no crash, success toast renders, page stays interactive.
